description: Brute forcing conversion(generating) from C# to Javascript.
releaseNotes:
**Highlight:**
Method "GenerateOneContinuously" continuously watching for file modifications: 
![Code_iv9ffQVn9R](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0917c97d-9db9-44d8-8093-caf91daa0bf3)
_Options used: UseStrictEquality, KeepBraceOnTheSameLine, NormalizeWhitespace_
